description: T-I5b-1 (F1) instanced foliage scatter set. Game content: the engine knows only the schema (archetype card size, tint, sway flag, density weight). Per-instance PLACEMENT is a deterministic pure hash of (chunk coords, biome id, slope, moisture, instance index); the per-column DENSITY comes from the biome table's vegetation block (data/common/biomes.json), modulated render-side by slope/moisture. RENDER-ONLY: nothing here feeds the sim or world_hash. The sway flag is per-archetype: grass/canopy wave with the A2 wind field; pebbles/clutter do not.
